agents.hint_name: Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, e.g. researcher

agents.add_card_sub: Build an agent in 3 steps — with the built-in assistant
agents.assist_box_text: The fastest path: answer a few questions — what the agent receives, what it should do and what the answer should look like — and the assistant will compose the instructions and suggest tools.
agents.persona_hint: Pick a persona — a ready skeleton of the description and instructions. You can refine everything in the next steps.
agents.hint_system_prompt: Write naturally — describe the goal and the answer style. The AI assistant above can refine it.
agents.persona_researcher_desc: Finds and summarises information from sources.
agents.persona_researcher_prompt: You are a researcher. You gather information from the available sources and tools, verify facts and summarise findings in a concise note with source references. When you do not know something, you say so explicitly.
agents.persona_writer_prompt: You are a documentation writer. Based on the provided material you write and update documentation: guides, feature descriptions and reports. You write clearly, structure the text with headings and always point to the sources.
agents.persona_critic_desc: Reviews quality and points out gaps.
agents.persona_critic_prompt: You are a quality critic. You check the completeness and consistency of the received content, list gaps and inconsistencies and propose concrete fixes. You review factually, without softening the problems.
agents.persona_supervisor_desc: Coordinates the process and other agents.
agents.persona_supervisor_prompt: You are a process supervisor. You break the task into steps, delegate work to specialised sub-agents, watch the iteration budget and decide when the result is ready for review.
agents.persona_tester_prompt: You are a QA tester. Based on requirements and specifications you create clear manual test cases: title, preconditions, steps and expected result. You cover positive, edge and negative cases. You write concisely.
agents.persona_custom_desc: Start from scratch and describe it yourself.
agents.tools_section_hint: The group switch = the whole addon (addon.*). Expand a group to pick individual tools.
agents.tools_footer_hint: The list comes from installed addons and the core. Data access is always checked against the permissions of the person running the agent.
agents.slider_iterations_desc: How many loop iterations the agent may run before returning the result.
agents.routable_desc: Other agents and flows may route tasks to this agent automatically. Turn off to run it manually only.
agents.enabled_desc: A disabled agent does not accept new runs.
agents.model_hint: A model or alias from the available list. Empty = the model from the request.
agents.pg_banner: Test mode — you talk directly to the agent and see the whole run next to it: iterations, tools and sub-agents. Each message starts a separate run.
agents.pg_placeholder: Ask the agent in test mode…
agents.pg_greeting: Test mode started. Describe a task — I will run it and show the whole run in the panel next to the chat.
agents.assist_banner: Answer in your own words. From your answers I will compose the system prompt and pick the tools.
agents.assist_intro: Hi! Let's build the agent step by step. Start with the essentials — what should this agent do?
agents.tpl_intro: Instead of building agents one by one, create a whole team. A template creates a full set of agents; you can adjust each of them later in the editor.
agents.tpl_own_agent: Prefer to build your own agent?
agents.tpl_conflict: Agents with these names already exist: {names}
agents.tpl_docqa_desc: The writer drafts a document from knowledge, the critic returns gaps, and the supervisor drives the fix loop until the text meets the criteria.
agents.tpl_test_desc: The generator drafts cases from requirements, the executor turns them into UI tests, and the reporter compiles a summary of the results.
agents.tpl_research_desc: The researcher gathers material from sources and the summariser condenses the findings into one note with citations.
agents.tpl_agent_writer_role: Writer — drafts content from the knowledge base
agents.tpl_agent_supervisor_role: Supervisor — watches the loop and iteration budget
agents.tpl_agent_generator_role: Generator — creates test cases from requirements
agents.tpl_agent_executor_role: Executor — builds UI tests from scenarios
agents.tpl_agent_executor_prompt: You are a test automation engineer. Based on approved manual scenarios you write end-to-end Playwright tests (TypeScript): stable selectors, assertions and data setup. You return complete, runnable code.
agents.tpl_agent_reporter_role: Reporter — summarises results and files defects
agents.tpl_agent_reporter_prompt: You are a test results reporter. You collect run results, summarise them in a readable report (what passed, what failed and why) and list proposed defect reports with reproduction steps.
agents.tpl_agent_researcher_role: Researcher — gathers sources from the web and knowledge
agents.tpl_agent_summarizer_role: Summariser — condenses findings into a note
agents.tpl_agent_summarizer_prompt: You are a summariser. You condense the provided material into one concise note: key findings, conclusions and open questions, always with source references.
